# Language Voice Tutor

Language Voice Tutor is a Windows desktop application for practicing real-life spoken language lessons with AI-assisted conversation scenarios.

The Windows desktop app is available through the Direct Windows download channel. Android and iOS apps are planned but not currently available. Paid subscription features are being rolled out carefully through the official website and app checkout flow; Premium access is managed by backend account status.
